plan.source_anchor: 前者的语义判断留给人手工补齐，后者把来源支持、读者卡点、图法、可见证据与落位记录在同一份页面 manifest 中。
plan.reader_block: A reader should see that the Skill packages the meaning relationship, not merely the requested image.
plan.source_relation: A picture-only prompt leaves the semantic decision outside the artifact, while the Skill connects source support, reader block, grammar proof, and placement in one manifest.
plan.core_judgment: 先判断关系，再生成画面
plan.subtitle: 普通 Prompt 与关系驱动交付的区别
plan.visual_solution: A small left loose paper sheet carries only one isolated abstract mark with no attached source anchor or placement relation; a distinct right page-shaped manifest has four visibly connected, unevenly placed abstract semantic marks for source support, reader block, visual grammar, and placement.
must_show: The left alternative is a lone sheet with one isolated abstract mark and no visible connection to source support or placement.
The right alternative visibly connects source support, reader block, visual grammar, and placement to one manifest page.
The two alternatives remain structurally different when their labels are hidden.
must_not_imply: that ordinary image prompting is invalid
that the manifest supplies facts absent from the source
that this is a software interface or screenshot
comparison_basis: The picture-only alternative is disconnected from source support and placement.
The Skill alternative visibly joins source support, reader block, grammar proof, and placement in one page manifest.

local_colours.target: the single connection entering the manifest page
local_colours.rationale: emphasize the source-supported relation without treating it as a product colour

visible_evidence: One alternative is a lone paper sheet with one isolated abstract mark and no attached relation marks.
The other alternative is a page form with four visibly connected semantic marks and a local placement mark.
The object boundary and connection difference remains visible without text.

scene_integrity.rationale: The page compares information structures rather than representing a real-world subject.

plan.reader_block: A reader should see that planning, page-level Prompt generation, and QA are ordered stages rather than interchangeable steps.
plan.source_relation: The workflow moves from planning to page-level Prompt generation and then to QA of existing generated images.
plan.core_judgment: 从叙事到可落位的视觉包
plan.subtitle: 每一步都保留在同一份页面 manifest 中
plan.visual_solution: Three small, uneven paper-state forms move left to right: a source-supported plan, a compiled page Prompt, and an existing generated image under QA; one thin directional route passes through all three.
must_show: Three ordered states run from planning to page-level Prompt to finalized placement.
A single thin route visibly connects the states in one direction.
The last state visibly inspects an already generated image rather than creating a new image.
must_not_imply: that QA is automatically enabled or automatically redraws images
that the workflow rewrites the source prose
that a separate plan or run file is created

local_colours.target: the one directional route from plan to delivery
local_colours.rationale: make the source-supported ordered transition legible

visible_evidence: Three distinct page states appear in one left-to-right order.
One thin directional route connects the first state to the second and then the third.
The final state visibly inspects an existing image, distinguishing QA from generation.

scene_integrity.rationale: The page visualizes an information workflow with abstract page states, not a real-world scene.

items.target: ordered route through the three states

plan.reader_block: A reader should see that the same relationship-to-visual workflow branches into three task-specific delivery contexts.
plan.source_relation: One shared visual workflow serves three distinct user-task categories: article packages, continuous presentations, and explanatory pages for training.
plan.core_judgment: 同一 Skill，服务三类叙事任务
plan.subtitle: 文章、连续讲述与解释页由不同任务带入
plan.visual_solution: One small shared source-narrative node sits above three uneven lower branches: an article package with a cover and anchor mark, a continuous sequence of three linked frames, and one explanatory page with a simple process mark. The branches are visibly subordinate to the shared node, not a timeline.
must_show: One shared source-narrative parent node sits above three visibly subordinate task branches.
The three branches have different output structures: an anchored article package, a continuous presentation sequence, and an explanatory training page.
The branching remains a parent-child classification rather than an ordered process.
must_not_imply: that the three uses occur in sequence
that the Skill produces editable PPTX files
that the Skill rewrites articles or replaces training content

local_colours.rationale: identify the common relationship source across the three categories

visible_evidence: A single upper parent node connects downward to three lower branches.
Each branch has a visibly different source-supported delivery structure.
There are no arrowheads or stage order cues, preserving classification rather than sequence.

scene_integrity.rationale: The page classifies task and delivery structures without representing people or literal industries.
